title: RBI Penalty on IndusInd Bank and Three NBFCs for Regulatory Lapses
description: <cite index="25-1,25-3">RBI imposed a Rs 59.20 lakh penalty on IndusInd Bank for non-compliance with certain provisions of directions on deposit rates and securitisation of standard assets</cite>. <cite index="25-5,25-6,25-7">Three NBFCs were also penalised: Fusion Finance (Rs 2.7 lakh for KYC non-compliance), Muthoot MCred (Rs 3.1 lakh for asset classification violations involving NPA account upgrades without full repayment)</cite>.
